verdict.rationale: Runloop's core product is Devboxes, which its docs describe as secure, isolated Linux sandboxes for running AI agents' code. These are backed by documented command execution, egress network policies, and credential-shielding gateways that keep API keys out of the sandbox. Together these directly address running untrusted AI-generated code away from your own infrastructure. missing for 10: technical detail on the isolation boundary (e.g., VM/microVM vs container), independent or hands-on corroboration of the security claims.
